scope: Offline only when root explicitly requests scoring after all required predictions seal; no online material/support selection

primary_support.strict_comparison: chi>.5 for BOTH effective-cell GT and prediction
primary_support.metric: IoU intersection/union on all1728 unknown voxels
primary_support.meaning: Effective cell-averaged contrast threshold, not exact continuous geometric volume
primary_support.empty_union_rule: IoU1 when both masks empty; otherwise ordinary intersection/union

regional_metrics.interpretation: Fixed effective-contrast bins; fractional high-material boundary cells can fall in lower bins; not automatically geometric phase masks

legacy_Otsu.scope: Thresholds independently computed from a stored volume; report full threshold convention; never replace fixed support metric

prediction_selection: Frozen lowest public physical Phi; score never selects iterate/algorithm/candidate
known_threshold_boundary: v04 was amended before generation to lowest bulk chi1; executed18 include v02/v09/v04/v08, all lowest positive bulk chi>=1. Unexecuted v11/v12 draft still contain chi=.5, excluded by strict support definition if ever used.
